archive.notes: Deterministic archive fixture regenerated from current mods/stash source files, including bml-package.json, workshop.toml, and checksums.json.

runtime.notes: The v1 runtime path is the BML-owned installed-binary hook/bootstrap contract. For validated jml.stash manifests, the production Stash bundle now loads by default only on the verified Steam/Linux target. Windows is modeled as a fail-closed launch-adapter contract; buildable scaffold DLL/launcher self-tests are scaffold-build evidence only, and playable support still requires a production Windows hook/build manifest plus live Windows runtime evidence. Live Linux evidence covers the lobby access point/prompt; fake-provider evidence covers generated-shop placement and shared inventory binding; player-facing generated-shop, persistence, spell, save/resume, disabled, multiplayer, and all Windows gameplay scenarios remain unverified.

platforms.notes: Only verified production path today. Requires the installed Steam/Linux build 22630456 executable, the checked libbarony_bml.so hook, and the pinned Linux hook manifest.

Contract only. Local scaffold builds may produce barony_bml.dll and bml-win-launcher.exe for fail-closed self-tests, but those artifacts must not be registered as playable support. Windows remains blocked unless running on Windows with a registered canonical launcher path, hook DLL, matching production build manifest/checksums, and live runtime evidence.

hookLibrary.notes: The hook library can load, report, pass the fake-symbol absolute-jump detour self-test, classify decoder-safe Stash target prologues, install the production playable Stash bundle for validated jml.stash manifests, place the lobby access point from x=232/y=280 with nearest-walkable-tile adjustment on Start Map, bind framework and spell Void Chests to the persistent stash inventory, install generated-shop placement, and detour uidToEntity plus Language::get so framework Stash access points show the scoped hover prompt "Open stash" instead of the vanilla "Open chest". The opt-in access/placement pass-through proof covers eight targets: actChest, actChestLid, generateDungeon, assignActions, newEntity, setSpriteAttributes, uidToEntity, and Language::get; the current y=280 source-level placement update still needs Linux live recheck.

hookManifest.notes: Pins Steam app/build, Linux platform, game version, executable hash/build id, 30 symbol probes, and Stash hook target groups including uidToEntity and Language::get prompt-scoped targets.

runtimeInfo.notes: Fixture declares installed-binary-hook policy, Linux LD_PRELOAD support, Windows create-process/load-library scaffold metadata using canonical bml-win-launcher.exe naming, and rejects partial/platform-mismatched Stash loads.

runtimeProvenance.notes: Release provenance is the installed Steam/Linux executable plus BML hook artifacts. Windows provenance is intentionally not claimed as playable: fail-closed scaffold DLL/launcher builds and self-tests, when present, are scaffold-build evidence only and no production Windows hook/build manifest or live Windows evidence is recorded yet. Historical fail-closed reports are retained only as diagnostic evidence from earlier opt-in probes; they are not the current top-level runtime status.

compatibility.notes: The current verified release target is Steam/Linux app 371970 build 22630456. Live quickstart evidence verifies the production lobby Stash access point and prompt. Windows support is metadata-only until a Windows runtime artifact and live Windows evidence exist; real generated-shop placement, persistence, spell-created Void Chest behavior, save/resume, disabled behavior, and multiplayer mismatch rejection remain unverified on every platform.

patches.notes: Historical source patch retained as a design reference and checksummed semantic artifact; it is not applied, built, or required by the v1 installed-binary-hook runtime.
Historical source-level Stash hook reference retained as a checksummed semantic artifact; production gameplay release support comes through installed-executable hook targets.

patchSeries.notes: Patch files remain checksummed semantic/source references only. The primary v1 release provenance is runtimeProvenance.installed-binary-hook.

buildArtifacts.notes: No patched/source-built Barony executable is claimed for this v1 release manifest. The installed Steam/Linux executable identity is recorded under runtimeProvenance.installedExecutable. Windows native scaffold builds are fail-closed/self-test-only and are therefore not release/playable build artifacts.

artifactVerification.notes: Release artifact provenance is present for the installed Steam/Linux hook path. Windows scaffold artifacts, if built locally, are intentionally self-test-only and are not represented as playable release artifacts.

reports.notes: Runtime load reporting is the canonical hook-load report path for profiles.
Symbol probing can identify required Steam/Linux symbols without claiming gameplay hooks are installed.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_DETOUR_SELF_TEST=1 and validates the fake-symbol absolute-jump detour, near-target trampoline allocation, relocated RIP-relative cmp displacement, relocated short conditional branch prologue, and trampoline call-through.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_STASH_DETOUR_SELF_TEST=1 and validates an opt-in fake-symbol Entity::addItemToVoidChestServer detour plus trampoline call-through without claiming in-game Stash behavior.

Historical native hook smoke with BML_STASH_INSTALL_ADD_ITEM_PASSTHROUGH=1 validated an opt-in process-lifetime pass-through detour install for Entity::addItemToVoidChestServer; its BML_STASH_HOOKS_NOT_INSTALLED result is retained as non-current fail-closed diagnostic evidence.

Historical native hook smoke with BML_STASH_INSTALL_CORE_PASSTHROUGH=1 validated opt-in process-lifetime pass-through detour installs for Entity::getChestInventoryList, Entity::addItemToChest, Entity::getItemFromChest, Entity::addItemToVoidChestServer, Entity::removeItemFromVoidChestServer, Entity::closeChest, and Entity::closeChestServer; its BML_STASH_HOOKS_NOT_INSTALLED result is retained as non-current fail-closed diagnostic evidence.

Historical native hook smoke with BML_STASH_INSTALL_ACCESS_PLACEMENT_PASSTHROUGH=1 and BML_STASH_ACCESS_PLACEMENT_SELF_TEST=1 validated opt-in process-lifetime pass-through detour installs for actChest, actChestLid, generateDungeon, assignActions, newEntity, setSpriteAttributes, uidToEntity, and Language::get, and proved fake-provider call-through including scoped prompt replacement. Current production Stash activation is no longer represented by this fail-closed diagnostic mode.

Historical fake-provider access/placement self-test validated trampoline call-through for actChest, actChestLid, generateDungeon, assignActions, newEntity, setSpriteAttributes, uidToEntity, and Language::get, including generateDungeonResult=7, selected-entity and uidToEntity hover-tooltip scoped "Open stash" prompt replacement, and replacement coverage for every installed access/placement/prompt target.

Historical non-mutating placement discovery ran with BML_STASH_PLACEMENT_DISCOVERY=1 plus access/placement pass-through install. It observed Start Map assignActions context and no placed Stash sprites before production placement was implemented; it is retained as historical discovery, not current runtime status.

Historical native hook smoke with BML_STASH_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_CORE_BEHAVIOR=1 and BML_STASH_CORE_BEHAVIOR_SELF_TEST=1 under the fake provider validates versioned v2 TSV state-backed load/add/remove/save over stats[0]->void_chest_inventory, preserves owner/shop/metadata fields, exercises generic Entity::addItemToChest and Entity::getItemFromChest mutation against the same bound list, and asserts a Stash load failure returns NULL instead of exposing stale inventory after fail-closed diagnostics. Historical timed Steam/Linux probes also verified the seven-target core inventory lifecycle diagnostic path in the installed executable without player-facing assertions.

Required Stash targets currently report with a conservative static/readiness split (42 ready, 0 blocked, 0 missing across the five Stash hook groups for Steam/Linux build 22630456) and the live symbol probe resolves all 30 required symbols. Production Stash activation is installed for validated jml.stash manifests; BML_STASH_DISABLE_PLAYABLE remains available for diagnostic probes.

installedHookVerification.notes: Current status is production loaded for validated jml.stash manifests on the pinned Steam/Linux executable. Fake-provider evidence covers lobby and generated-shop placement hooks, shared stash inventory binding, metadata guard, and scoped Open stash prompt; live quickstart/in-game evidence covers the lobby access point and prompt. Windows launch/runtime verification is absent by design, so any Windows path must fail closed until production Windows artifacts and live evidence are registered.

requiredScenarios: persistent Void Chest inventory across death, new run, and process relaunch
save/resume without duplicate or forked stash state
disabled package leaves vanilla Void Chest behavior unmodified
builtGameBehavior.notes: Historical live quickstart=barbarian against the stock Steam/Linux executable plus LD_PRELOAD hook verified runtime-load status=loaded, all 30 required symbols resolved, and state/stash-diagnostics.jsonl recorded a lobby stash access point on Start Map at x=232.000/y=456.000. Jeremy then confirmed in-game that the placement/lid/prompt worked for that build. Current source now moves the lobby anchor to x=232.000/y=280.000 and snaps to the nearest walkable tile; Linux live recheck of the adjusted coordinate is pending. No Windows runtime has been run or verified in this production branch. Fake-provider self-test verifies generated-shop placement logic and shared inventory/spell binding, but real generated-shop placement, persistence across run boundaries, spell-created Void Chest interaction, save/resume, disabled behavior, and multiplayer rejection remain pending.

rollback.notes: Rollback means disabling the jml.stash package and launching the installed Barony executable without the BML hook/bootstrap environment.
steps: Disable jml.stash in the profile package state before launch.
Launch the installed Steam/Linux Barony executable without LD_PRELOAD or BML hook environment variables; for future Windows scaffolds, launch barony.exe without the BML launcher/load-library adapter.
Preserve BaronyModLoader profile state, hook reports, and stash inventory files for inspection; do not delete user data unless explicitly requested.
Regenerate launch/runtime manifests after the package is disabled so stale capability metadata and hook provenance are not reused.
rollback.risk: Existing experimental stash state may be unreadable by vanilla Barony or later hook revisions; preserve it separately rather than silently converting or deleting it. Windows state migration is not defined until Windows runtime artifacts are real and verified.
